_id: HETERONYM CARD METHOD — four steps, per heteronym, one at a time
_why: Cards were built by grep and justified by prose. Doing them one at a time is only worth it if each one is done completely.

rules: ENTERS this position's room or discipline -> the traversal plate
NAMES the position without entering it -> the naming section
ANOTHER HETERONYM'S -> remove; it belongs nowhere on this card
MISCATEGORISED AS A TRAVERSAL BUT THEIRS -> relocate to where it belongs, UNLESS redundant there or it does not advance the record
and: no deposit on two plates
steps.definition: A traversal is a record of a machine encountering the archive. A room is a specification; a traversal is that room executed. Navigation maps, charters, captures and registries are NOT traversals.

steps.2: DOUBLINGS — every plate, not only traversals
steps.note: Sigil carried MACHINE RECEPTION twice as well as twelve traversals twice. Check the whole card, not the section being worked.

steps.3: JOURNAL PLATE — rebuild from the journals data
steps.note: The journal plates that exist are now often WRONG. They predate the 2026-08-15 duoviri ruling and the venue records. Build from datasets/venues/records/*.json joined on registry_string, not from what the card says.

Journals and presses for that heteronym, on their own site. VISUALLY PARALLEL TO THAT SITE'S HETERONYM CARD and sharing the site-wide nav bar where one exists. Cranes at axnidentifiers is the template. Link its own site's stylesheet; declare no colours and no classes the card does not already use.

steps.rule: A capture belongs on a card when the QUERY names the heteronym, their works, their concepts, their institution or their journal — or when the MACHINE OUTPUT composes them. Nothing else qualifies.
steps.NEVER_MATCH_ON: the 'd' and 'analysis' fields. Those are THE ARCHIVE'S OWN NOTES ABOUT a capture, not evidence from it. Matching on them put a Bing biography answering 'who is lee sharks?' on Johannes Sigil's card, because an annotator had written 'Grammata' in the note.
steps.and: Do not optimise the selection for coverage of sections or match types before the population is right. Chasing coverage is what forced the biography in — it was the only capture carrying MANTLE CONSOLIDATION. A representative sample of the wrong population is still the wrong population.
steps.cap: No more than 20. Fewer is better. Link out to alexanarch.org/captures/ for the rest.

steps.rule: Every record carries one. Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable, INVENT IT — but MARK EACH INVENTED ROW IN-UNIVERSE, using the att classes the cards already carry: reconstructed vs deposited, attested, hashed, live.
steps.why: An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.

steps.rule: Every record carries one. Each marker cites the DEPOSIT that states it. A marker belongs to whoever deposited it — do not take markers from a deposit credited to someone else.
steps.where_to_find: Two places. Some are already on the page as spxi: meta tags in the head, readable by a machine and not by a person (Sigil). Some exist only in the deposits and must be read out (Trace, Kuro).

steps.rule: Every capture row resolves to alexanarch.org/captures/#slug. Rebuilding a plate from capture data drops the links every time.
steps.note: Missed on four cards in a row. Not a judgement call; a script.

steps.9: MAJOR WORKS AGAINST THE VENUES DATA
steps.rule: Check every major-work plate entry against datasets/journals/assignments.jsonl. A Pocket Humans volume whose series_status is not  MUST NOT BE PRESENTED AS AN EXISTING WORK.
steps.found: Trace #196 — eight deposits identified, no gathered edition minted. Now stated on the plate.
steps.note: Feist #124 and Wells #440 are FORTHCOMING; their cards are not yet built and must not render covers.
steps.cover_rule: A cover MAY render for an unmade work IF the cover itself declares the status on its face. Wells #440 carries a poster reading NOT YET PROJECTED, and the plate says the poster IS the film — an imaginary solution declared as one. The defect is a cover that implies existence, not a cover as such. The gate already implements this: a plate stating its status passes.
steps.corrected: 2026-08-17 — the rule said no cover at all; that was wrong and the poster is the case that showed it.

_open: fraction morrow glas wells vox dancings feist spellings: all seven steps

plate_order._rule: CATEGORISED CHIP PLATES FIRST, then three plates that are a different kind of thing, in this order at the end: SURFACE HISTORY, SEMANTIC INTEGRITY MARKERS, MACHINE RECEPTION. MACHINE RECEPTION IS ALWAYS THE LAST CATEGORY ON EVERY RECORD.
plate_order._why: The chip plates list the position's own work and relations. The final three are about the surface itself, its doctrine, and how machines received it — not categories of work, and they should not be interleaved with plates that are.
